summary: Correction to the published-lists pending catch-up note: the 'pending: missions kept changing' and 'pending: work kept changing' rebuild counts it mentions are read only by tests. In production, only the daemon log and the per-path publish latency show how the missions and work lists behave through a burst.

replay.detail: A release note correction only; nothing in the daemon changes.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, registry or coordinated member upgrade change.

manual.detail: To watch a burst, read the 'publish missions' and 'publish work' latency (the projection-fresh paths of /v1/client/request-latency) and look for 'kept changing in ways no short fold can follow' in the daemon log. A fold that carries rows over leaves no other trace outside tests.
